summary: Implemented every stub in my 40 assigned statsmodels files (dataset loaders, Edgeworth expansion, BDS test, proportion tests and intervals, Theil-GLS, RecursiveLS, truncated and hurdle count models, Markov switching and autoregression, Hannan-Rissanen, tsatools helpers, factor rotation wrapper, and sandbox gof, sppatch and penalized helpers); the Sison-Glaz multinomial interval is left as NotImplementedError. The last full-suite result I saw was none, since the package still fails to import (statespace/tools.py lacks prepare_exog, another builder's file), so passed and failed are -1; standalone checks matched the references for Edgeworth, BDS, the proportion chi-square, all-pairs and z tests, the tsatools helpers and the gof bootstrap.
